|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Melas (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-melas022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/melas.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Light/large/melas.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Melas”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Opponent's starships here may not 'cloak.' Smoke Screen is a Used Interrupt when targeting Melas.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Melas (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 3 October 2022<ref name="img-melasca1ccff">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/melas.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Light/large/melas.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Melas” → “Melas” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. Opponent's starships here may not 'cloak.' Smoke Screen is a Used Interrupt when targeting Melas.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Melas (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 30 December 2024<ref name="img-melas9d2c01e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/melas.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b commit 9d2c01e] (30 December 2024); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Light/large/melas.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Your StarSpeeders are destiny +2 and move for free.
